notes.text:
An update is available for hplip.
This update affects Rocky Linux 10.
A Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS) base score, which gives a detailed severity rating, is available for each vulnerability from the CVE list
notes.title: Topic

notes.text:
The hplip packages contain the Hewlett-Packard Linux Imaging and Printing Project (HPLIP), which provides drivers for Hewlett-Packard printers and multi-function peripherals.

Security Fix(es):

* hplip: HP Linux Imaging and Printing Software - Use of DSA Key (CVE-2025-43023)

* hplip: HPLIP: Multiple vulnerabilities enabling local code execution and privilege escalation (CVE-2026-91099)

* hplip: HPLIP: Multiple vulnerabilities allow remote code execution and privilege escalation (CVE-2026-91098)

* hplip: HPLIP: Multiple vulnerabilities enable remote code execution and privilege escalation (CVE-2026-91097)

* hplip: HPLIP: Multiple vulnerabilities leading to remote code execution, privilege escalation, and denial of service (CVE-2026-91103)

* hplip: heap-based buffer overflow can lead to remote code execution (CVE-2026-91106)

* hplip: HPLIP: Multiple vulnerabilities allow remote code execution, privilege escalation, and denial of service. (CVE-2026-91100)

* hplip: HPLIP: Remote Code Execution and Privilege Escalation Vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-91101)

* hplip: heap-based buffer overflow can lead to remote code execution (CVE-2026-91104)

* hplip: HPLIP: Remote code execution and privilege escalation vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-91105)

* HPLIP: HPLIP: Multiple vulnerabilities could lead to remote code execution (CVE-2026-91102)

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* [IMAGE-MODE] missing /var/lib/hp on image-mode [rhel-10] (JIRA:Rocky Linux-266547)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.

This advisory is provided by Ctrl IQ, Inc for Rocky Linux systems. For more information about CIQ security practices, visit https://ciq.com/security.
